groundTruthSource.note: Reviewed at this commit: the wordpress dependency at line 26 of helm-dependency/Chart.yaml declares `repository: https://charts.helm.sh/stable` (version 9.0.3). The Helm Chart Repository Deprecation Update (https://helm.sh/blog/charts-repo-deprecation/) states that the stable chart repository stopped accepting updates on 2020-11-13 and that downloads redirect to a read-only archive.
